skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 70% ATK Direct DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Enters [Berserk], building up to 2 charge layers (var101), then deals Direct DMG to the target's entire column scaling with the number of charge layers. Also Dispels buffs from himself.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: No change to values — identical to the Ultimate: [Berserk] with up to 2 charge layers, then Direct DMG to the target's entire column scaling with charge layers, and self-Dispel.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently gains +20% HP. At his turn start, Dispels buffs from 3 random enemies. After attacking, applies a debuff to the enemies he hit. At his turn end, gains a stack of [Berserk].

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Turn-start Dispel targets 3 > 4 enemies. All other effects unchanged.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: No change to values — identical to the Extreme Passive (turn-start Dispel still targets 4 enemies).

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: When taking fatal damage, revives with 70% HP the next round. Gains [Tenacity] upon revival (absorbs up to 50% Max HP of DMG). Activates once per battle.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: Revival once > twice per battle. [Tenacity] absorb 50% > 70% Max HP.

effects.desc: Attack buffs increase damage based on conditions (e.g. each marked enemy), amplifying the amount of Fury-type damage the unit deals.
